item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:05 HKT 19/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring showers and thunderstorms to Guangdong midweek this week. With upper-air disturbances departing, the weather will be very hot over the region towards the weekend. A trough of low pressure will form over central China in the latter part of this week. It will edge closer to the coast of southern China and bring showers to the region over the weekend.
